nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when a workflow with this Error Workflow assigned fails. Provides execution id, node name, and bounded error text.

nodes.name: Supabase — fail lead processing
nodes.notes: Marks the open received claim failed and moves the lead to needs_review. Returns false when no claim exists (failure before claim).

nodes.name: Telegram — notify lead intake failure
nodes.notes: Workflow/execution/node/bounded error only. Credential and chat ID are manual post-import setup.

parameters.content:
## Manual setup after import

1. Assign this workflow in the lead intake workflow **Settings → Error Workflow**.
2. Create a **Telegram API** credential and select it in `Telegram — notify lead intake failure`.
3. Replace `YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` with your chat id.

DB failure marking and Telegram run in parallel from the Error Trigger so a Supabase error does not block the alert attempt.

See `automation/workflows/lead-error-handler-README.md`.
